101	def short(sha: str | None) -> str:
102	    return sha[:7] if sha else "-"
103	
104	
105	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- model
106	
107	@dataclass
108	class Sub:
109	    name: str
110	    path: str
111	    url: str | None
112	    branch: str | None
113	    policy: str | None
114	    bump: str | None
115	    tier: str | None
116	    update: str | None
117	
118	    @property
119	    def eff_policy(self) -> str:
120	        # An undeclared policy is treated as pin: never moved implicitly.
121	        return self.policy if self.policy in POLICIES else "pin"
122	
123	    @property
124	    def eff_bump(self) -> str:
125	        if self.eff_policy != "track":
126	            return "manual"
127	        return self.bump if self.bump in BUMP_MODES else "manual"
128	
129	    def eff_branch(self, root: Path) -> str:
130	        if self.branch == ".":
131	            return git("symbolic-ref", "-q", "--short", "HEAD", cwd=root, check=False) or "main"
132	        if self.branch:
133	            return self.branch
134	        # Undeclared: follow the child's remote default (main, master, ...).
135	        head = git("symbolic-ref", "-q", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD", cwd=root / self.path, check=False)
136	        return head.removeprefix("origin/") if head.startswith("origin/") else "main"
137	
138	
139	def find_root(explicit: str | None) -> Path:
140	    if explicit:
141	        root = Path(explicit).resolve()
142	        if not (root / ".gitmodules").exists():
143	            raise UsageError(f"{root} has no .gitmodules")
144	        return root
145	    cwd = Path.cwd()
146	    for cand in (
147	        git("rev-parse", "--show-superproject-working-tree", cwd=cwd, check=False),
148	        git("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel", cwd=cwd, check=False),
149	    ):
150	        if cand and (Path(cand) / ".gitmodules").exists():
151	            return Path(cand).resolve()
152	    # Inside a child worktree under .worktrees/: walk up to the superproject.
153	    for base in [cwd, *cwd.parents]:
154	        if (base / ".gitmodules").exists() and (base / ".git").exists():
155	            return base.resolve()
156	    raise UsageError("not inside a superproject (no .gitmodules found); pass --root")
157	
158	
159	def load_subs(root: Path) -> list[Sub]:
160	    if not (root / ".gitmodules").exists():
161	        return []
162	    out = subprocess.run(
163	        ["git", "config", "-z", "-f", ".gitmodules", "--get-regexp", r"^submodule\."],
164	        cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV,
165	    ).stdout
166	    entries: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
167	    for rec in out.split("\0"):
168	        if not rec:
169	            continue
170	        key, _, value = rec.partition("\n")
171	        name, _, var = key[len("submodule."):].rpartition(".")
172	        entries.setdefault(name, {})[var.lower()] = value
173	    return [
174	        Sub(
175	            name=name, path=e["path"].rstrip("/"), url=e.get("url"), branch=e.get("branch"),
176	            policy=e.get("x-policy"), bump=e.get("x-bump"), tier=e.get("x-tier"),
177	            update=e.get("update"),
178	        )
179	        for name, e in entries.items()
180	        if "path" in e
181	    ]
182	
183	
184	def gitlink(root: Path, path: str, tree: str = "HEAD") -> str | None:
185	    out = git("ls-tree", tree, "--", path, cwd=root, check=False)
186	    m = re.match(r"160000 commit ([0-9a-f]+)\t", out)
187	    return m.group(1) if m else None
188	
189	
190	def index_gitlink(root: Path, path: str) -> str | None:
191	    out = git("ls-files", "-s", "--", path, cwd=root, check=False)
192	    m = re.match(r"160000 ([0-9a-f]+) 0\t", out)
193	    return m.group(1) if m else None
194	
195	
196	def is_initialized(root: Path, sub: Sub) -> bool:
197	    p = root / sub.path
198	    if not (p / ".git").exists():
199	        return False
200	    top = git("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel", cwd=p, check=False)
201	    return bool(top) and Path(top).resolve() == p.resolve()
202	
203	
204	def fetch(repo: Path) -> str | None:
205	    p = subprocess.run(
206	        ["git", "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", "origin"],
207	        cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV,
208	    )
209	    return None if p.returncode == 0 else p.stderr.strip() or "fetch failed"
210	
211	
212	def resolve(subs: list[Sub], ident: str) -> Sub:
213	    ident = ident.rstrip("/")
214	    hits = [s for s in subs if ident in (s.name, s.path)]
215	    if not hits:
216	        hits = [s for s in subs if Path(s.path).name == ident]
217	    if len(hits) != 1:
218	        known = ", ".join(s.name for s in subs)
219	        raise UsageError(f"{'ambiguous' if hits else 'unknown'} submodule {ident!r} (known: {known})")
220	    return hits[0]
221	
222	
223	def select(subs: list[Sub], args: argparse.Namespace, default) -> list[Sub]:
224	    names = getattr(args, "names", None) or []
225	    if names:
226	        chosen = [resolve(subs, n) for n in names]
227	    elif any(getattr(args, k, None) for k in ("tier", "policy")):
228	        chosen = list(subs)
229	    else:
230	        chosen = [s for s in subs if default(s)]
231	    if getattr(args, "tier", None):
232	        chosen = [s for s in chosen if s.tier == args.tier]
233	    if getattr(args, "policy", None):
234	        chosen = [s for s in chosen if s.eff_policy == args.policy]
235	    if getattr(args, "mode", None):
236	        chosen = [s for s in chosen if s.eff_bump == args.mode]
237	    return chosen
238	
239	
240	def sub_state(root: Path, sub: Sub, *, do_fetch: bool = False) -> dict:
241	    p = root / sub.path
242	    branch = sub.eff_branch(root)
243	    st: dict = {
244	        "name": sub.name, "path": sub.path, "policy": sub.policy, "bump": sub.eff_bump,
245	        "tier": sub.tier, "branch": branch, "recorded": gitlink(root, sub.path),
246	        "staged": None, "initialized": is_initialized(root, sub), "warnings": [],
247	    }
248	    staged = index_gitlink(root, sub.path)
249	    if staged and staged != st["recorded"]:
250	        st["staged"] = staged
251	    if not st["initialized"]:
252	        return st
253	    if do_fetch and (err := fetch(p)):
254	        st["warnings"].append(f"fetch failed: {err}")
255	    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=p, check=False) or None
256	    upstream = f"refs/remotes/origin/{branch}"
257	    st.update(
258	        head=head,
259	        checkout_branch=git("symbolic-ref", "-q", "--short", "HEAD", cwd=p, check=False) or None,
260	        dirty=tracked_dirty(p),
261	        drift=bool(head and st["recorded"] and head != st["recorded"]),
262	        upstream_exists=ref_exists(p, upstream),
263	        lag=None, unpushed=None, recorded_reachable=None, recorded_on_remote=None, head_reachable=None,
264	        worktrees=list_child_worktrees(root, sub),
265	    )
266	    if not st["upstream_exists"]:
267	        st["warnings"].append(f"origin/{branch} missing locally (fetch, or fix `branch`)")
268	        return st
269	    rec = st["recorded"]
270	    if rec and has_commit(p, rec):
271	        left, right = git("rev-list", "--left-right", "--count", f"{rec}...{upstream}", cwd=p).split()
272	        st.update(unpushed=int(left), lag=int(right), recorded_reachable=int(left) == 0)
273	        st["recorded_on_remote"] = st["recorded_reachable"] or bool(remote_refs_containing(p, rec))
274	    elif rec:
275	        st["warnings"].append(f"recorded commit {short(rec)} not present locally (fetch?)")
276	    if head:
277	        st["head_reachable"] = is_ancestor(p, head, upstream)
278	    return st
279	
280	
281	def list_child_worktrees(root: Path, sub: Sub) -> list[dict]:
282	    p = root / sub.path
283	    base = (root / WORKTREE_DIR).resolve()
284	    out = git("worktree", "list", "--porcelain", cwd=p, check=False)
285	    found = []
286	    for block in out.split("\n\n"):
287	        info: dict = {}
288	        for line in block.splitlines():
289	            k, _, v = line.partition(" ")
290	            info[k] = v or True
291	        wt = info.get("worktree")
292	        if not isinstance(wt, str) or not Path(wt).resolve().is_relative_to(base):
293	            continue
294	        br = info.get("branch")
295	        found.append({
296	            "path": str(Path(wt).resolve().relative_to(root.resolve())),
297	            "branch": br.removeprefix("refs/heads/") if isinstance(br, str) else None,
298	            "head": info.get("HEAD"),
299	            "prunable": "prunable" in info,
300	        })
301	    branch = sub.eff_branch(root)
302	    for wt in found:
303	        wt["merged"] = bool(
304	            wt["head"] and wt["branch"] != branch
305	            and is_ancestor(p, wt["head"], f"refs/remotes/origin/{branch}")
306	        )
307	        if not wt["prunable"] and (root / wt["path"]).exists():
308	            wt["dirty"] = tracked_dirty(root / wt["path"])
309	    return found
310	
311	
312	def emit(args: argparse.Namespace, data, text: str) -> None:
313	    if args.json:
314	        print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
315	    else:
316	        print(text)
317	
318	
319	def table(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:
320	    if not rows:
321	        return ""
322	    widths = [max(len(r[i]) for r in rows) for i in range(len(rows[0]))]
323	    return "\n".join("  ".join(c.ljust(w) for c, w in zip(r, widths)).rstrip() for r in rows)
324	
325	
326	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- status
327	
328	def describe(st: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
329	    if not st["initialized"]:
330	        return "uninit", ""
331	    bits = []
332	    if st["checkout_branch"]:
333	        bits.append(f"on {st['checkout_branch']}")
334	    else:
335	        bits.append("detached")
336	    if st["dirty"]:
337	        bits.append(f"dirty({st['dirty']})")
338	    if st["drift"]:
339	        bits.append(f"head {short(st['head'])} != gitlink")
340	    if st["staged"]:
341	        bits.append(f"staged {short(st['staged'])}")
342	    if st["recorded_on_remote"] is False:
343	        bits.append("gitlink NOT on any origin branch")
344	    elif st["recorded_reachable"] is False:
345	        bits.append(f"gitlink off origin/{st['branch']} (on another origin branch)")
346	    if st["worktrees"]:
347	        bits.append(f"{len(st['worktrees'])} worktree(s)")
348	    bits += st["warnings"]
349	    lag = "-" if st["lag"] is None else str(st["lag"])
350	    return lag, "; ".join(bits)
351	
352	
353	def cmd_status(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
354	    chosen = select(subs, args, lambda s: True)
355	    states = [sub_state(root, s, do_fetch=args.fetch) for s in chosen]
356	    rows = [["NAME", "POLICY", "BUMP", "TIER", "GITLINK", "LAG", "STATE"]]
357	    for st in states:
358	        lag, note = describe(st)
359	        rows.append([
360	            st["name"] if st["name"] == st["path"] else f"{st['name']} ({st['path']})",
361	            st["policy"] or "(unset)", st["bump"], st["tier"] or "-",
362	            short(st["recorded"]), lag, note,
363	        ])
364	    hint = "" if args.fetch else "\n(lag uses local remote refs; add --fetch for current numbers)"
365	    emit(args, {"root": str(root), "cli_version": __version__, "submodules": states}, table(rows) + hint)
366	    return 0
367	
368	
369	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- init
370	
371	def cmd_init(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
372	    chosen = select(subs, args, lambda s: args.all or s.eff_policy != "lazy")
373	    results = []
374	    for s in chosen:
375	        if is_initialized(root, s):
376	            results.append({"name": s.name, "action": "skipped",
377	                            "reason": "already initialized; init never moves a checkout (use pull/bump)"})
378	            continue
379	        cmd = ["submodule", "update", "--init"]
380	        if s.eff_policy == "lazy" or s.update == "none":
381	            cmd.append("--checkout")  # override update=none for an explicit request
382	        if args.recursive:
383	            cmd.append("--recursive")
384	        cmd += ["--", s.path]
385	        if not args.dry_run:
386	            git("submodule", "sync", "--", s.path, cwd=root)
387	            git(*cmd, cwd=root)
388	        results.append({"name": s.name, "action": "would-init" if args.dry_run else "initialized",
389	                        "command": "git " + " ".join(cmd)})
390	    text = "\n".join(f"{r['action']:12} {r['name']}" + (f"  ({r['reason']})" if "reason" in r else "")
391	                     for r in results) or "nothing selected"
392	    emit(args, {"results": results}, text)
393	    return 0
394	
395	
396	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pull
397	
398	def pull_one(root: Path, s: Sub, args) -> dict:
399	    p = root / s.path
400	    branch = s.eff_branch(root)
401	    up = f"origin/{branch}"
402	    res = {"name": s.name, "branch": branch}
403	    if s.eff_policy != "track" and not args.force:
404	        raise Refused(f"policy is {s.policy or 'unset (treated as pin)'}; pass --force to move it")
405	    if not is_initialized(root, s):
406	        raise Refused("not initialized; run `init` first")
407	    if not args.no_fetch and (err := fetch(p)):
408	        raise Refused(f"fetch failed: {err}")
409	    if not ref_exists(p, f"refs/remotes/{up}"):
410	        raise Refused(f"{up} does not exist")
411	    if tracked_dirty(p):
412	        raise Refused("uncommitted changes in the checkout")
413	    cur = git("symbolic-ref", "-q", "--short", "HEAD", cwd=p, check=False)
414	    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=p)
415	    if cur and cur != branch:
416	        raise Refused(f"checkout is on branch {cur!r}; develop in `worktree add`, keep the checkout on {branch}")
417	    if not cur and not is_ancestor(p, head, up):
418	        raise Refused(f"detached commit {short(head)} is not on {up}; save it on a branch first")
419	    if ref_exists(p, f"refs/heads/{branch}"):
420	        local = git("rev-parse", branch, cwd=p)
421	        behind, ahead = is_ancestor(p, local, up), is_ancestor(p, up, local)
422	        if not behind and not ahead:
423	            raise Refused(f"local {branch} has diverged from {up}; resolve manually")
424	        if not behind:
425	            res["warning"] = f"local {branch} has unpushed commits; bump will refuse until pushed"
426	    target = git("rev-parse", up, cwd=p)
427	    res.update({"from": head, "to": target})
428	    if head == target and cur == branch:
429	        res["action"] = "up-to-date"
430	        return res
431	    if args.dry_run:
432	        res["action"] = "would-update"
433	        return res
434	    if not cur:
435	        if ref_exists(p, f"refs/heads/{branch}"):
436	            git("switch", branch, cwd=p)
437	        else:
438	            git("switch", "--track", "-c", branch, up, cwd=p)
439	    git("merge", "--ff-only", up, cwd=p)
440	    res["to"] = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=p)
441	    res["action"] = "updated"
442	    return res
443	
444	
445	def cmd_pull(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
446	    chosen = select(subs, args, lambda s: s.eff_policy == "track" and is_initialized(root, s))
447	    results, failed = [], False
448	    for s in chosen:
449	        try:
450	            results.append(pull_one(root, s, args))
451	        except Refused as e:
452	            failed = True
453	            results.append({"name": s.name, "action": "refused", "reason": str(e)})
454	    lines = []
455	    for r in results:
456	        detail = r.get("reason") or f"{short(r.get('from'))} -> {short(r.get('to'))}"
457	        lines.append(f"{r['action']:12} {r['name']}  {detail}" + (f"  [{r['warning']}]" if r.get("warning") else ""))
458	    if any(r["action"] == "updated" for r in results):
459	        lines.append("checkouts moved; record them with `bump` (gitlinks are unchanged until then)")
460	    emit(args, {"results": results}, "\n".join(lines) or "nothing selected")
461	    return 1 if failed else 0
462	
463	
464	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- preflight / bump
465	
466	def check_commit(root: Path, s: Sub, sha: str, *, require_clean: bool) -> list[str]:
467	    """Problems that make `sha` unsafe to record as this submodule's gitlink."""
468	    p = root / s.path
469	    branch = s.eff_branch(root)
470	    if not is_initialized(root, s):
471	        return ["not initialized; cannot verify the commit"]
472	    problems = []
473	    if require_clean and tracked_dirty(p):
474	        problems.append("uncommitted changes in the checkout")
475	    if not has_commit(p, sha):
476	        return problems + [f"{short(sha)} does not exist in the child repo"]
477	    if s.eff_policy != "track":
478	        # A pin may sit on any pushed branch (e.g. a production baseline); it must only be recoverable.
479	        if not remote_refs_containing(p, sha):
480	            problems.append(f"{short(sha)} is not reachable from any origin branch; push the child commit (then fetch)")
481	        return problems
482	    if not ref_exists(p, f"refs/remotes/origin/{branch}"):
483	        return problems + [f"origin/{branch} missing; cannot prove {short(sha)} is pushed"]
484	    if not is_ancestor(p, sha, f"origin/{branch}"):
485	        problems.append(f"{short(sha)} is not reachable from origin/{branch}; push the child commit (then fetch)")
486	    return problems
487	
488	
489	def cmd_preflight(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
490	    by_path = {s.path: s for s in subs}
491	    findings = []
492	    if git("ls-files", "-u", cwd=root):
493	        for line in git("ls-files", "-u", cwd=root).splitlines():
494	            if line.startswith("160000"):
495	                findings.append({"path": line.split("\t", 1)[1], "level": "error", "message": "unmerged gitlink"})
496	    raw = git("diff", "--cached", "--raw", "--no-abbrev", cwd=root)
497	    staged = []
498	    for line in raw.splitlines():
499	        m = re.match(r":\d+ (\d+) [0-9a-f]+ ([0-9a-f]+) \w+\t(.+)", line)
500	        if m and m.group(1) == "160000":
501	            staged.append((m.group(3), m.group(2)))
502	    for path, sha in staged:
503	        s = by_path.get(path)
504	        if not s:
505	            findings.append({"path": path, "level": "error", "message": "gitlink not declared in .gitmodules"})
506	            continue
507	        if args.fetch and is_initialized(root, s):
508	            fetch(root / s.path)
509	        for msg in check_commit(root, s, sha, require_clean=False):
510	            findings.append({"path": path, "level": "error", "message": msg})
511	        if is_initialized(root, s):
512	            p = root / s.path
513	            if tracked_dirty(p):
514	                findings.append({"path": path, "level": "warn", "message": "checkout has uncommitted changes"})
515	            if git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=p, check=False) != sha:
516	                findings.append({"path": path, "level": "warn", "message": "checkout HEAD differs from the staged gitlink"})
517	    errors = [f for f in findings if f["level"] == "error"]
518	    text = "\n".join(f"{f['level']:5} {f['path']}: {f['message']}" for f in findings)
519	    if not staged:
520	        text = text or "No staged gitlink changes."
521	    elif not findings:
522	        text = f"ok: {len(staged)} staged gitlink(s) are pushed and reachable"
523	    emit(args, {"staged": [{"path": p, "sha": s} for p, s in staged], "findings": findings, "ok": not errors}, text)
524	    return 1 if errors else 0
525	
526	
527	def cmd_bump(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
528	    if not args.names and not args.all_track:
529	        raise UsageError("name submodules to bump, or pass --all-track")
530	    chosen = select(subs, args, lambda s: args.all_track and s.eff_policy == "track" and is_initialized(root, s))
531	    planned, refused, results = [], [], []
532	    for s in chosen:
533	        p = root / s.path
534	        res = {"name": s.name, "path": s.path, "policy": s.policy}
535	        try:
536	            if s.eff_policy != "track" and not args.reason:
537	                raise Refused(f"policy is {s.policy or 'unset (treated as pin)'}; pass --reason to move it")
538	            if not is_initialized(root, s):
539	                raise Refused("not initialized")
540	            if not args.no_fetch and (err := fetch(p)):
541	                raise Refused(f"fetch failed: {err}")
542	            head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=p)
543	            old = gitlink(root, s.path)
544	            res.update({"from": old, "to": head})
545	            if head == old and index_gitlink(root, s.path) == old:
546	                res["action"] = "up-to-date"
547	                results.append(res)
548	                continue
549	            if problems := check_commit(root, s, head, require_clean=True):
550	                raise Refused("; ".join(problems))
551	            if old and has_commit(p, old):
552	                res["commits"] = int(git("rev-list", "--count", f"{old}..{head}", cwd=p))
553	            res["action"] = "would-bump" if args.dry_run else "staged"
554	            planned.append((s, res))
555	        except Refused as e:
556	            res.update(action="refused", reason=str(e))
557	            refused.append(res)
558	        results.append(res)
559	
560	    commit_sha = None
561	    if refused and not args.partial:
562	        for _, res in planned:
563	            res["action"] = "aborted"
564	    elif planned and not args.dry_run:
565	        paths = [s.path for s, _ in planned]
566	        if args.commit:
567	            others = set(git("diff", "--cached", "--name-only", cwd=root).splitlines()) - set(paths)
568	            if others and not args.allow_other_staged:
569	                raise Refused(f"other staged changes would join the bump commit: {', '.join(sorted(others))}")
570	        git("add", "--", *paths, cwd=root)
571	        if args.commit:
572	            git("commit", "-F", "-", cwd=root, input=bump_message(root, planned, args))
573	            commit_sha = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=root)
574	            for _, res in planned:
575	                res["action"] = "committed"
576	
577	    lines = []
578	    for r in results:
579	        if r["action"] == "refused":
580	            lines.append(f"refused      {r['name']}  {r['reason']}")
581	        else:
582	            n = f" (+{r['commits']})" if r.get("commits") is not None else ""
583	            lines.append(f"{r['action']:12} {r['name']}  {short(r.get('from'))} -> {short(r.get('to'))}{n}")
584	    if refused and not args.partial:
585	        lines.append("aborted: one cross-repo change gets one outer commit; fix the refusals or pass --partial")
586	    if commit_sha:
587	        lines.append(f"committed {short(commit_sha)}")
588	    elif planned and not args.dry_run and not (refused and not args.partial):
589	        lines.append("gitlinks staged; review with `git diff --cached --submodule=log`, then commit (or rerun with --commit)")
590	    emit(args, {"results": results, "commit": commit_sha}, "\n".join(lines) or "nothing selected")
591	    return 1 if refused else 0
592	
593	
594	def bump_message(root: Path, planned: list[tuple[Sub, dict]], args) -> str:
595	    names = [s.name for s, _ in planned]
596	    subject = args.subject or (
597	        f"chore(submodules): bump {', '.join(names)}" if len(names) <= 3
598	        else f"chore(submodules): bump {len(names)} submodules"
599	    )
600	    body = []
601	    for s, r in planned:
602	        n = f" (+{r['commits']})" if r.get("commits") is not None else ""
603	        body.append(f"- {s.name}: {short(r['from'])}..{short(r['to'])}{n} [{s.policy or 'unset'}]")
604	    if args.reason:
605	        body += ["", f"Reason: {args.reason}"]
606	    log = git("diff", "--cached", "--submodule=log", "--", *[s.path for s, _ in planned], cwd=root)
607	    if log:
608	        body += ["", log]
609	    return subject + "\n\n" + "\n".join(body) + "\n"

612	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- worktrees
613	
614	def wt_path(root: Path, s: Sub, branch: str) -> Path:
615	    return root / WORKTREE_DIR / s.path / branch.replace("/", "-")
616	
617	
618	def ensure_gitignore(root: Path, dry_run: bool) -> bool:
619	    """Return True when .gitignore needs (or got) the .worktrees/ entry."""
620	    if git_rc("check-ignore", "-q", "--no-index", f"{WORKTREE_DIR}/probe", cwd=root) == 0:
621	        return False
622	    if not dry_run:
623	        gi = root / ".gitignore"
624	        text = gi.read_text() if gi.exists() else ""
625	        sep = "" if not text or text.endswith("\n") else "\n"
626	        gi.write_text(f"{text}{sep}# superproject-workspace: child worktrees\n{WORKTREE_DIR}/\n")
627	    return True
628	
629	
630	def cmd_worktree(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
631	    if args.wt_cmd == "list":
632	        chosen = [s for s in subs if is_initialized(root, s)]
633	        items = [dict(wt, submodule=s.name) for s in chosen for wt in list_child_worktrees(root, s)]
634	        rows = [["SUBMODULE", "BRANCH", "PATH", "STATE"]]
635	        for wt in items:
636	            state = ["prunable"] if wt["prunable"] else []
637	            if wt.get("dirty"):
638	                state.append(f"dirty({wt['dirty']})")
639	            if wt["merged"]:
640	                state.append("merged: safe to remove")
641	            rows.append([wt["submodule"], wt["branch"] or "(detached)", wt["path"], ", ".join(state)])
642	        emit(args, {"worktrees": items}, table(rows) if items else "no child worktrees")
643	        return 0
644	
645	    s = resolve(subs, args.submodule)
646	    p = root / s.path
647	    if not is_initialized(root, s):
648	        raise Refused(f"{s.name} is not initialized; run `init {s.name}` first")
649	    target = wt_path(root, s, args.branch)
650	    rel = str(target.relative_to(root))
651	
652	    if args.wt_cmd == "remove":
653	        cmd = ["worktree", "remove", *(["--force"] if args.force else []), str(target)]
654	        if not args.dry_run:
655	            git(*cmd, cwd=p)
656	            git("worktree", "prune", cwd=p)
657	            if args.delete_branch:
658	                git("branch", "-D" if args.force else "-d", args.branch, cwd=p)
659	        emit(args, {"removed": rel, "dry_run": args.dry_run}, f"{'would remove' if args.dry_run else 'removed'} {rel}")
660	        return 0
661	
662	    # add
663	    if target.exists():
664	        raise Refused(f"{rel} already exists")
665	    if not args.no_fetch:
666	        fetch(p)
667	    branch = s.eff_branch(root)
668	    if ref_exists(p, f"refs/heads/{args.branch}"):
669	        cmd, base = ["worktree", "add", str(target), args.branch], args.branch
670	    elif ref_exists(p, f"refs/remotes/origin/{args.branch}"):
671	        base = f"origin/{args.branch}"
672	        cmd = ["worktree", "add", "--track", "-b", args.branch, str(target), base]
673	    else:
674	        # Pinned children branch from the recorded baseline, not from upstream tip.
675	        base = args.base or (f"origin/{branch}" if s.eff_policy == "track" else gitlink(root, s.path))
676	        cmd = ["worktree", "add", "-b", args.branch, str(target), base]
677	    gi = ensure_gitignore(root, args.dry_run)
678	    if not args.dry_run:
679	        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
680	        git(*cmd, cwd=p)
681	    data = {"path": rel, "branch": args.branch, "base": base, "gitignore_updated": gi, "dry_run": args.dry_run}
682	    emit(args, data, f"{'would create' if args.dry_run else 'created'} {rel} on {args.branch} from {base}"
683	         + ("\nadded .worktrees/ to .gitignore" if gi else ""))
684	    return 0
685

689	def find_agents_file(root: Path) -> Path | None:
690	    for name in ("AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"):
691	        if (root / name).exists():
692	            return root / name
693	    return None

696	def find_justfile(root: Path) -> Path | None:
697	    for name in ("justfile", "Justfile", ".justfile"):
698	        if (root / name).exists():
699	            return root / name
700	    return None

702	
703	def cmd_audit(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
704	    f: list[dict] = []
705	
706	    def add(level: str, code: str, subject: str, message: str, fix: str = "") -> None:
707	        f.append({"level": level, "code": code, "subject": subject, "message": message, "fix": fix})
708	
709	    if not subs:
710	        add("error", "no-submodules", ".gitmodules", "no submodules declared")
711	    for s in subs:
712	        if s.policy is None:
713	            add("warn", "policy-missing", s.name, "no x-policy; treated as pin",
714	                f"git config -f .gitmodules submodule.{s.name}.x-policy track|pin|lazy")
715	        elif s.policy not in POLICIES:
716	            add("error", "policy-invalid", s.name, f"x-policy={s.policy!r} (expected {'|'.join(POLICIES)})")
717	        if s.bump and s.bump not in BUMP_MODES:
718	            add("error", "bump-invalid", s.name, f"x-bump={s.bump!r} (expected {'|'.join(BUMP_MODES)})")
719	        if s.bump in ("pr", "direct") and s.eff_policy != "track":
720	            add("warn", "bump-ignored", s.name, f"x-bump={s.bump} has no effect on a {s.eff_policy} submodule")
721	        if s.eff_policy == "track" and not s.branch:
722	            add("warn", "branch-missing", s.name, "track without `branch`; assuming main",
723	                f"git config -f .gitmodules submodule.{s.name}.branch main")
724	        if s.policy == "lazy" and s.update != "none":
725	            add("warn", "lazy-update", s.name, "lazy without `update = none`; plain `git submodule update --init` will fetch it",
726	                f"git config -f .gitmodules submodule.{s.name}.update none")
727	        if s.policy in ("track", "pin") and s.update == "none":
728	            add("warn", "update-none", s.name, f"{s.policy} child has update=none; plain git will never check it out")
729	        st = sub_state(root, s, do_fetch=args.fetch)
730	        if not st["initialized"]:
731	            if s.eff_policy != "lazy":
732	                add("warn", "uninitialized", s.name, f"{s.eff_policy} child is not initialized", f"init {s.name}")
733	            continue
734	        configured = git("config", "--get", f"submodule.{s.name}.url", cwd=root, check=False)
735	        if s.url and configured and configured != s.url and not s.url.startswith("."):
736	            add("warn", "url-unsynced", s.name, f".git/config url differs from .gitmodules ({configured})",
737	                f"git submodule sync -- {s.path}")
738	        if st["recorded_on_remote"] is False:
739	            add("error", "gitlink-unreachable", s.name,
740	                f"recorded {short(st['recorded'])} is on no origin branch; a fresh clone cannot check it out",
741	                "push the child commit, or move the pointer to a pushed commit")
742	        elif st["recorded_reachable"] is False:
743	            add("warn" if s.eff_policy == "track" else "info", "gitlink-off-branch", s.name,
744	                f"recorded {short(st['recorded'])} is pushed but not on origin/{st['branch']}",
745	                "merge the child branch, or set `branch` to the baseline it follows")
746	        if st["drift"]:
747	            add("info", "checkout-drift", s.name, f"checkout at {short(st['head'])}, gitlink at {short(st['recorded'])}",
748	                f"bump {s.name} to record it, or `git submodule update -- {s.path}` to discard")
749	        if st["dirty"]:
750	            add("info", "dirty", s.name, f"{st['dirty']} uncommitted change(s) in the checkout")
751	        if s.eff_policy == "track" and st["lag"]:
752	            add("warn", "behind", s.name, f"gitlink is {st['lag']} commit(s) behind origin/{st['branch']}",
753	                f"pull {s.name} && bump {s.name}")
754	        if s.eff_policy == "pin" and st["lag"]:
755	            add("info", "pin-behind", s.name, f"pinned {st['lag']} commit(s) behind origin/{st['branch']}")
756	        for w in st["worktrees"]:
757	            if w["prunable"]:
758	                add("info", "worktree-prunable", s.name, f"{w['path']} is gone", f"git -C {s.path} worktree prune")
759	            elif w["merged"]:
760	                add("info", "worktree-merged", s.name, f"{w['path']} ({w['branch']}) is merged",
761	                    f"worktree remove {s.name} {w['branch']} --delete-branch")
762	        for w in st["warnings"]:
763	            add("warn", "state", s.name, w)
764	
765	    agents = find_agents_file(root)
766	    if not agents or AGENTS_BEGIN not in agents.read_text():
767	        add("warn", "agents-block", agents.name if agents else "AGENTS.md",
768	            "no superproject-workspace guidance block for agents", "adopt")
769	    if git_rc("check-ignore", "-q", "--no-index", f"{WORKTREE_DIR}/probe", cwd=root) != 0:
770	        add("warn", "worktrees-not-ignored", ".gitignore", f"{WORKTREE_DIR}/ is not ignored", "adopt")
771	    jf = find_justfile(root)
772	    if jf:
773	        text = jf.read_text()
774	        hard = [s.path for s in subs if s.path in text]
775	        if JUST_BEGIN not in text and len(hard) >= 2:
776	            add("info", "justfile-hardcoded", jf.name,
777	                f"recipes hard-code {len(hard)} submodule paths; policy-driven recipes avoid per-child edits", "adopt")
778	    # The tool itself drifts too: compare managed blocks and any vendored copy to this CLI.
779	    if SKILL_ASSETS.exists():
780	        for target, begin, end, asset in (
781	            (agents, AGENTS_BEGIN, AGENTS_END, "agents-block.md.template"),
782	            (jf, JUST_BEGIN, JUST_END, "justfile.snippet"),
783	        ):
784	            block = extract_block(target.read_text(), begin, end) if target else None
785	            want = extract_block(render_asset(asset), begin, end)
786	            if block and want and block != want:
787	                add("warn", "managed-block-stale", target.name,
788	                    f"managed block differs from superproject-workspace {__version__}", "adopt")
789	    vendored = root / VENDORED_CLI
790	    if vendored.exists() and vendored.resolve() != Path(__file__).resolve() \
791	            and vendored.read_bytes() != Path(__file__).read_bytes():
792	        add("warn", "vendored-cli-stale", VENDORED_CLI,
793	            f"vendored CLI {cli_version(vendored)} differs from running CLI {__version__}",
794	            "adopt --vendor-cli to refresh, or delete it to use the installed skill")
795	    automated = [s for s in subs if s.eff_bump in ("pr", "direct")]
796	    wf_dir = root / ".github" / "workflows"
797	    has_ci = wf_dir.is_dir() and any("ci-plan" in w.read_text() or "superproject.py" in w.read_text()
798	                                      for w in wf_dir.glob("*.y*ml"))
799	    if automated and not has_ci:
800	        add("warn", "ci-missing", ".github/workflows",
801	            f"{len(automated)} child(ren) want automated bumps but no bump workflow exists", "adopt --with-ci")
802	    if git("config", "--get", "push.recurseSubmodules", cwd=root, check=False) not in ("check", "on-demand"):
803	        add("info", "push-check", "git config", "push.recurseSubmodules is not set; outer pushes can reference unpushed children",
804	            "git config push.recurseSubmodules check")
805	
806	    counts = {lvl: sum(1 for x in f if x["level"] == lvl) for lvl in ("error", "warn", "info")}
807	    order = {"error": 0, "warn": 1, "info": 2}
808	    lines = [f"{x['level']:5} {x['code']:22} {x['subject']}: {x['message']}" + (f"\n      fix: {x['fix']}" if x["fix"] else "")
809	             for x in sorted(f, key=lambda x: order[x["level"]])]
810	    lines.append(f"\n{counts['error']} error(s), {counts['warn']} warning(s), {counts['info']} info")
811	    emit(args, {"findings": f, "counts": counts}, "\n".join(lines))
812	    failed = counts["error"] or (args.strict and counts["warn"])
813	    return 1 if failed else 0
814

816	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- adopt
817	
818	def render_asset(name: str) -> str:
819	    path = SKILL_ASSETS / name
820	    if not path.exists():
821	        raise UsageError(f"asset {name} not found; run adopt from the installed skill, not a vendored copy")
822	    return path.read_text()
823	
824	
825	def extract_block(text: str, begin: str, end: str) -> str | None:
826	    m = re.search(re.escape(begin) + r".*?" + re.escape(end), text, re.S)
827	    return m.group(0) if m else None
828	
829	
830	def cli_version(path: Path) -> str:
831	    m = re.search(r'^__version__ = "([^"]+)"', path.read_text(), re.M)
832	    return m.group(1) if m else "?"
833	
834	
835	def upsert_block(text: str, begin: str, end: str, block: str) -> str:
836	    pattern = re.compile(re.escape(begin) + r".*?" + re.escape(end), re.S)
837	    if pattern.search(text):
838	        return pattern.sub(lambda _: block.strip("\n"), text, count=1)
839	    sep = "" if not text else ("\n" if text.endswith("\n") else "\n\n")
840	    return f"{text}{sep}\n{block.strip(chr(10))}\n" if text else block.strip("\n") + "\n"
841	
842	
843	def cmd_adopt(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
844	    actions: list[dict] = []
845	    overrides: dict[str, tuple[str, str | None]] = {}
846	    for spec in args.set or []:
847	        ident, _, val = spec.partition("=")
848	        pol, _, bump = val.partition(":")
849	        if pol not in POLICIES or (bump and bump not in BUMP_MODES):
850	            raise UsageError(f"--set {spec!r}: expected NAME=track|pin|lazy[:pr|direct|manual]")
851	        overrides[resolve(subs, ident).name] = (pol, bump or None)
852	
853	    def set_key(s: Sub, key: str, value: str) -> None:
854	        actions.append({"kind": "gitmodules", "target": f"submodule.{s.name}.{key}", "detail": value})
855	        if not args.dry_run:
856	            git("config", "-f", ".gitmodules", f"submodule.{s.name}.{key}", value, cwd=root)
857	
858	    for s in subs:
859	        forced = overrides.get(s.name)
860	        policy = forced[0] if forced else (s.policy or args.policy_default)
861	        if policy != s.policy:
862	            set_key(s, "x-policy", policy)
863	        if policy == "track":
864	            bump = (forced and forced[1]) or s.bump or args.bump_default
865	            if bump != s.bump:
866	                set_key(s, "x-bump", bump)
867	        if not s.branch and policy != "lazy":
868	            remote_head = ""
869	            if is_initialized(root, s):
870	                remote_head = git("symbolic-ref", "-q", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD",
871	                                  cwd=root / s.path, check=False).removeprefix("origin/")
872	            set_key(s, "branch", remote_head or "main")
873	        if policy == "lazy" and s.update != "none":
874	            set_key(s, "update", "none")
875	
876	    if args.vendor_cli:
877	        # Opt-in only (offline / air-gapped): a copy stops receiving skill updates.
878	        dest = root / VENDORED_CLI
879	        src = Path(__file__).resolve()
880	        if dest.resolve() != src and (not dest.exists() or dest.read_bytes() != src.read_bytes()):
881	            actions.append({"kind": "file", "target": VENDORED_CLI,
882	                            "detail": f"{'refresh' if dest.exists() else 'vendor'} CLI {__version__}"})
883	            if not args.dry_run:
884	                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
885	                shutil.copy2(src, dest)
886	
887	    if not args.no_agents:
888	        agents = find_agents_file(root) or root / "AGENTS.md"
889	        old = agents.read_text() if agents.exists() else ""
890	        new = upsert_block(old, AGENTS_BEGIN, AGENTS_END, render_asset("agents-block.md.template"))
891	        if new != old:
892	            actions.append({"kind": "file", "target": agents.name, "detail": "upsert agent guidance block"})
893	            if not args.dry_run:
894	                agents.write_text(new)
895	
896	    if not args.no_justfile:
897	        jf = find_justfile(root) or root / "justfile"
898	        old = jf.read_text() if jf.exists() else ""
899	        new = upsert_block(old, JUST_BEGIN, JUST_END, render_asset("justfile.snippet"))
900	        if new != old:
901	            actions.append({"kind": "file", "target": jf.name, "detail": "upsert sub-* recipes"})
902	            if not args.dry_run:
903	                jf.write_text(new)
904	
905	    if not args.no_gitignore and ensure_gitignore(root, args.dry_run):
906	        actions.append({"kind": "file", "target": ".gitignore", "detail": f"ignore {WORKTREE_DIR}/"})
907	
908	    if args.with_ci:
909	        wf = root / ".github" / "workflows" / "superproject-bump.yml"
910	        content = render_asset("superproject-bump.yml")
911	        if not wf.exists() or wf.read_text() != content:
912	            actions.append({"kind": "file", "target": str(wf.relative_to(root)), "detail": "scheduled bump workflow"})
913	            if not args.dry_run:
914	                wf.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
915	                wf.write_text(content)
916	
917	    if args.with_hook:
918	        hook = root / git("rev-parse", "--git-path", "hooks/pre-commit", cwd=root)
919	        if hook.exists():
920	            if render_asset("pre-commit-hook.sh") != hook.read_text():
921	                actions.append({"kind": "skipped", "target": "pre-commit hook",
922	                                "detail": "a different hook exists; chain `preflight` into it by hand"})
923	        else:
924	            actions.append({"kind": "file", "target": "pre-commit hook", "detail": "run preflight before commits"})
925	            if not args.dry_run:
926	                hook.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
927	                hook.write_text(render_asset("pre-commit-hook.sh"))
928	                hook.chmod(0o755)
929	
930	    if not args.no_git_config:
931	        for key, value in (("diff.submodule", "log"), ("status.submoduleSummary", "true"),
932	                           ("push.recurseSubmodules", "check")):
933	            if not git("config", "--local", "--get", key, cwd=root, check=False):
934	                actions.append({"kind": "git-config", "target": key, "detail": value})
935	                if not args.dry_run:
936	                    git("config", "--local", key, value, cwd=root)
937	
938	    verb = "would" if args.dry_run else "did"
939	    text = "\n".join(f"{verb}: {a['kind']:10} {a['target']} = {a['detail']}" for a in actions) or "already adopted; nothing to do"
940	    if actions and not args.dry_run:
941	        text += "\nreview with `git diff`, then run `audit`"
942	    emit(args, {"actions": actions, "dry_run": args.dry_run}, text)
943	    return 0
944	
945	
946	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ci-plan
947	
948	def cmd_ci_plan(root: Path, subs: list[Sub], args) -> int:
949	    chosen = [s for s in subs if s.eff_bump in ("pr", "direct")]
950	    if args.only:
951	        chosen = [s for s in chosen if s.name == args.only or s.path == args.only]
952	    plan = {mode: [{"name": s.name, "path": s.path, "branch": s.eff_branch(root)}
953	                   for s in chosen if s.eff_bump == mode] for mode in ("pr", "direct")}
954	    plan["init_paths"] = [s.path for s in chosen]
955	    text = "\n".join(f"{mode}: {', '.join(x['name'] for x in plan[mode]) or '-'}" for mode in ("pr", "direct"))
956	    emit(args, plan, text)
957	    return 0

960	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- CLI
961	
962	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
963	    common = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
964	    common.add_argument("--root", help="superproject root (default: discovered from cwd)")
965	    common.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="machine-readable output on stdout")
966	
967	    sel = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
968	    sel.add_argument("names", nargs="*", help="submodule name, path, or basename")
969	    sel.add_argument("--tier", help="only submodules with this x-tier")
970	    sel.add_argument("--policy", choices=POLICIES, help="only submodules with this effective policy")
971	
972	    dry = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
973	    dry.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="report what would change; change nothing")
974	
975	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
976	        prog="superproject.py",
977	        description="Keep a git-submodule superproject on track (policy-driven status, bump, worktrees, audit).",
978	        epilog="Policy lives in .gitmodules: x-policy=track|pin|lazy, x-bump=pr|direct|manual, x-tier=<group>.",
979	    )
980	    ap.add_argument("--version", action="version", version=f"%(prog)s {__version__}")
981	    sp = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
982	
983	    p = sp.add_parser("status", parents=[common, sel], help="policy, lag and drift for every child")
984	    p.add_argument("--fetch", action="store_true", help="fetch each child's origin first")
985	    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)
986	
987	    p = sp.add_parser("init", parents=[common, sel, dry],
988	                      help="initialize children (lazy ones only when named, by --tier, or with --all)")
989	    p.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="include lazy children")
990	    p.add_argument("--recursive", action="store_true", help="also initialize nested submodules")
991	    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_init)
992

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="Read"><details>

 `./skills/local/superproject-workspace/SKILL.md`

````text
1	---
2	name: superproject-workspace
3	description: Keep a git-submodule superproject (umbrella repo / multi-repo workspace used as one agent entry point) from drifting — per-submodule policy in .gitmodules (track / pin / lazy), lag and drift status, safe fast-forward, preflighted gitlink bumps in one outer commit, scheduled bump PRs, child worktrees, and audit/adopt for existing superprojects. Use when a repo has .gitmodules and the user asks to update/sync submodules, bump pointers, work on a branch inside a submodule, add a repo to the workspace, or asks "monorepo vs submodules", incl. "submodule 落後 / 更新 submodule / 拉到 latest main".
4	---
5	
6	# superproject-workspace
7	
8	A superproject is a repo whose job is to hold other repos as git submodules,
9	so that one agent session gets every repo's context and edit access while each
10	repo keeps its own remote, PRs, and release cycle. The cost: **a gitlink
11	records a commit, not a branch.** Children merge PRs and the superproject
12	silently falls behind; checkouts end up detached, dirty, or on stray branches;
13	pointers reference commits nobody pushed. Drift is the default, not a bug.
14	
15	This skill makes drift **visible** and moves pointers **by policy**, with one
16	CLI (`scripts/superproject.py`, stdlib Python ≥3.10, PEP 723). Every
17	superproject **references** the installed skill's CLI instead of copying it,
18	so `npx skills update` upgrades all of them at once. Otherwise the tool itself
19	would drift the same way the gitlinks do.
20	
21	## When to use
22	
23	- The repo has `.gitmodules` and the user wants to update, sync, or "pull latest" children.
24	- After a child PR merges, to move the superproject pointer.
25	- Starting feature work inside a child repo from the superproject.
26	- Adding a repo to a workspace, or deciding *how* to bring repos together (see `references/decision-guide.md`).
27	- Auditing or upgrading an older superproject that has ad-hoc recipes.
28	
29	## When NOT to use
30	
31	- Ordinary single-repo git work: use `git-workflow`.
32	- Issue/PR lifecycle inside one child: use that child's own workflow (`forge-native-dev`, etc.).
33	- The repos are not submodules (manifest + gitignored clones, or Project add-dir): only the decision guide applies.
34	
35	## The policy model
36	
37	Each child declares its policy as extra keys in `.gitmodules`. Git ignores keys
38	it does not know, so these keys live next to `path` and `url` and cannot fall
39	out of sync with them.
40	
41	```ini
42	[submodule "app"]
43	    path = app
44	    url = git@github.com:me/app.git
45	    branch = main        # tracking branch (native key; unset -> child's origin/HEAD)
46	    x-policy = track     # track | pin | lazy
47	    x-bump = pr          # pr | direct | manual   (only for track)
48	    x-tier = core        # free-form grouping for --tier selection
49	    update = none        # lazy only: plain `git submodule update --init` skips it
50	```
51	
52	| Policy | Means | Pointer moves | Initialized |
53	|---|---|---|---|
54	| `track` | "Be at the latest `origin/<branch>`" | `pull` (ff-only), then `bump`; may be automated (`x-bump`) | by default |
55	| `pin` | "Be at a known baseline" (production, a release, a reproduction) | only `bump --reason "..."` | by default |
56	| `lazy` | "Reference material; fetch only when a task needs it" | only `bump --reason` | only when named |
57	| unset | treated as `pin`; `audit` warns | | |
58	
59	Bump modes for `track`: `pr` means scheduled CI opens one PR on
60	`chore/submodule-bump`. `direct` means CI commits to the default branch after
61	preflight. `manual` means a human or agent runs `bump`. An umbrella where every
62	child follows main is simply "everything `track`". A workspace hub mixes core
63	`pin`s with `lazy` references. Details and example configs are in
64	`references/policies.md`.
65	
66	## Workflow
67	
68	Below, `sp` means `uv run --script <skill-dir>/scripts/superproject.py`. For a
69	global install, `<skill-dir>` is `~/.agents/skills/superproject-workspace`.
70	After `adopt`, the same commands are available as `just sub-*` recipes. They
71	resolve the CLI in this order, first match wins:
72	
73	1. `$SUPERPROJECT_CLI`
74	2. a vendored `scripts/superproject.py` (opt-in)
75	3. the project skill install `.agents/skills/...`
76	4. the global install `~/.agents/skills/...`
77	5. GitHub raw at `$SUPERPROJECT_CLI_REF` (default `main`)
78	
79	`just sub-which` prints which one won. Every command takes `--json`. Mutating
80	commands take `--dry-run`.
81	
82	### 1. Look first
83	
84	```bash
85	sp status --fetch   # policy, lag, drift, dirty, worktrees
86	sp audit            # findings + exact fix commands
87	```
88	
89	Without `--fetch`, lag is computed against stale remote refs. Never report
90	"up to date" without fetching.
91	
92	### 2. Get a child you need
93	
94	```bash
95	sp init                 # all non-lazy, uninitialized children
96	sp init some-reference  # a lazy child, by name/path/basename
97	```
98	
99	`init` never touches an already-initialized checkout and does not recurse
100	unless you pass `--recursive`. Initialization is not a way to update.
101	
102	### 3. Develop inside a child: use a child worktree
103	
104	```bash
105	sp worktree add app feat/login
106	# -> .worktrees/app/feat-login  (gitignored; branch from origin/main for track,
107	#    from the recorded gitlink for pin, so fixes start from the baseline)
108	```
109	
110	Work, commit, push, and open the PR **in the child's own repo and workflow**.
111	The submodule checkout itself stays on its branch or pin. Clean up with
112	`worktree list` (shows merged ones) and `worktree remove app feat/login --delete-branch`.
113	Do not create worktrees of the superproject for this; see `references/worktrees.md`.
114	
115	### 4. Move pointers: inside-out, one outer commit
116	
117	```bash
118	sp pull                 # ff track children (checkout only)
119	sp bump --all-track --commit
120	sp bump lib --reason "prod baseline v2.3" --commit   # pin/lazy
121	```
122	
123	`bump` refuses the whole set if any child is dirty or its commit is not
124	pushed. For a `track` child, "pushed" means on `origin/<branch>`; for a pin, it
125	means on any origin branch. One cross-repo change gets one outer commit. The
126	commit body contains each range and the `--submodule=log` summary. Pass
127	`--partial` only when the user explicitly accepts splitting.
128	
129	### 5. Guard every outer commit
130	
131	```bash
132	sp preflight   # also installed as a pre-commit hook by adopt --with-hook
133	```
134	
135	### 6. Adopt an existing superproject
136	
137	```bash
138	uv run --script <skill>/scripts/superproject.py audit --root ../old-super
139	uv run --script <skill>/scripts/superproject.py adopt --root ../old-super --dry-run \
140	    --policy-default pin --set app=track:pr --set docs-ref=lazy
141	```
142	
143	`adopt` writes policy keys, but only where they are missing or named by
144	`--set`. It also upserts a marker-delimited AGENTS.md block and `sub-*`
145	justfile recipes, adds `.worktrees/` to `.gitignore`, and sets local git
146	config:
147	- `diff.submodule=log`
148	- `status.submoduleSummary=true`
149	- `push.recurseSubmodules=check`
150	
151	Opt in to `--with-ci` and `--with-hook`. It does **not** copy the CLI. Pass
152	`--vendor-cli` only for offline or air-gapped superprojects, and accept that
153	the copy stops receiving fixes. It is idempotent: rerun it (`just sub-adopt`)
154	after a skill update to refresh the managed blocks. `audit` reports
155	`managed-block-stale` and `vendored-cli-stale` when the tool itself has
156	drifted. Review `git diff`
157	before committing, and pick policies with the user. The default
158	`--policy-default pin` is deliberately conservative.
159	
160	## Available scripts
161	
162	- **`scripts/superproject.py`**: `status | init | pull | bump | preflight | worktree add|list|remove | audit | adopt | ci-plan`.
163	  - Common flags: `--root`, `--json`, `--dry-run` (mutating commands).
164	  - Selection: positional names (name, path, or basename), `--tier`, `--policy`, `--mode`.
165	  - Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 refused or check failed, 2 usage error. Diagnostics go to stderr.
166	
167	## Bundled assets
168	
169	- `assets/justfile.snippet`: thin `sub-*` recipes (marker block; `adopt` upserts it).
170	- `assets/agents-block.md.template`: the cross-repo contract for agents (marker block).
171	- `assets/superproject-bump.yml`: scheduled, `workflow_dispatch`, and `repository_dispatch` bump workflow (`pr` and `direct`).
172	- `assets/child-dispatch.yml`: optional; goes in a child repo to request an immediate bump on push to main.
173	- `assets/pre-commit-hook.sh`: runs `preflight`.
174	
175	The recipes, hook, and workflow all use the same CLI resolution. CI pins
176	the version with the `SUPERPROJECT_CLI_REF` repository variable (a tag or
177	SHA).
178	
179	## Reference files
180	
181	- `references/decision-guide.md`: read when choosing between a real monorepo, a submodule superproject, a manifest with clones, or Project add-dir.
182	- `references/policies.md`: read when assigning policies, or for umbrella vs hub examples.
183	- `references/worktrees.md`: read before any branch work inside a child.
184	- `references/ci-bump.md`: read when enabling `pr`/`direct` automation, private or GitLab children, or dispatch.
185	- `references/agent-entry.md`: read when setting up the superproject as an agent entry point (AGENTS.md layering, Claude/Codex Projects, root context).
186	- `references/gotchas.md`: read when git prints something surprising about a submodule.
187	- `references/case-patterns.md`: read when adopting; lists lessons from real umbrella and hub superprojects.
188	
189	## Gotchas
190	
191	- **Don't copy the CLI into each superproject.** Copies freeze at adoption
192	  time and silently diverge across repos. Reference the installed skill; vendor
193	  only for offline use, and let `audit` flag stale copies.
194	- **`git pull` in the superproject does not update children.** It moves gitlinks and leaves checkouts behind, which then shows as `modified: app (new commits)`. Run `status`, then decide whether to `bump` (keep the checkout) or `git submodule update -- app` (discard and go back to the gitlink).
195	- **`git submodule update` detaches HEAD** and can strand local commits that are not on a branch. `pull` refuses "detached commit not on origin/<branch>" for this reason; save the commit to a branch first.
196	- **"Latest" never means resetting pins.** A pinned child may legitimately be behind or sit on a release branch. `audit` reports this as info, not an error.
197	- **Never bump to an unpushed child commit.** A fresh clone would then fail with `fatal: remote error: upload-pack: not our ref`. `bump` and `preflight` block this, and `push.recurseSubmodules=check` blocks the outer push.
198	- **A submodule name is not its path.** One example is `[submodule "dotfiles"] path = dotfiles-unix`. Policy keys use the *name*. The CLI accepts either.
199	- **CI PRs opened with `GITHUB_TOKEN` do not trigger other workflows.** Run the gates inside the bump job, or use a PAT or GitHub App token (`references/ci-bump.md`).
200	- **After a child's URL changes in `.gitmodules`**, existing clones keep the old URL until `git submodule sync`. `init` syncs, and `audit` flags `url-unsynced`.
201
